rationale: The assistant correctly identified Er03 as the liquid/object-on-controls safety cut-off, matching the hidden truth, and tied it directly to the customer's reported boil-over. Instructions were safe (isolate, cool, clean, dry, power cycle) with an explicit warning not to open the hob and a conditional, appropriately hedged escalation to AEG service only if the code persists on a dry panel. No parts were recommended and no evidence was invented; it asked no clarifying questions, but given the unambiguous evidence a direct fix with a conditional fallback was proportionate.
